# MyCalcFinance

> Free online financial calculators for smarter money decisions.

MyCalcFinance (https://mycalcfinance.com) provides 10+ free browser-based financial calculators. No login, no data collection, fully client-side.

## Financial Calculators
- Mortgage Calculator: Monthly payment with amortization schedule, PMI, taxes, and insurance.
- Compound Interest Calculator: Investment growth projections with regular contributions.
- Retirement Calculator: How much you need to retire based on savings rate and expenses.
- Tax Bracket Calculator: Federal tax estimation with bracket breakdown.
- Salary Calculator: Annual-to-hourly and hourly-to-annual wage conversion.
- Capital Gains Tax Calculator: Short-term and long-term capital gains tax estimation.
- Net Worth Calculator: Track assets minus liabilities for total net worth.
- Budget Planner: 50/30/20 budgeting rule with category breakdowns.
- Break-Even Calculator: Revenue needed to cover fixed and variable costs.
- Inflation Calculator: How purchasing power changes over time.

## Blog
Personal finance guides including mortgage tips, compound interest strategies, retirement planning, tax optimization, and budgeting advice.
